title: Eight-Week Standard
summary: A balanced 56-day plan for most students: four two-week diagnose, fix and test cycles covering every domain in both sections, with a full mock every two weeks and a final-week taper. About 6–9 hours a week, with a lighter taper week at the end.

resources.label: SAT Practice Bank (filter by domain, skill and difficulty)

error_codes.meaning: Content: did not know the rule, formula or skill
Process: knew it but set it up or read it wrongly
Time: rushed or ran out of time
Named slip: a specific, nameable careless error
Guess-right: correct but unsure; review as a miss

schedule.who_for: You have about two months, can study 6–9 hours a week, and want steady progress in both sections. Works from roughly 900 up; higher scorers should swap medium sets for hard ones from week 3.
rules: Each two-week cycle: mock on day 1, forensic review on day 2, fixes, then timed modules at the end of the second week.
Two fix targets per cycle, chosen by (misses × official domain weight).
Clear the Reviews queue at least four days a week.
Re-solve every Notebook entry two days after logging it.

phases.label: Cycle 1: foundations
phases.goal: Baseline mock; conventions and linear algebra to automatic; Desmos basics.

phases.label: Cycle 2: core skills
phases.goal: Evidence and data in R&W; quadratics, exponentials and functions in Math.

phases.label: Cycle 3: reasoning and applications
phases.goal: Words in context, structure, cross-text; data analysis, geometry and trigonometry.

phases.label: Cycle 4: hard modules and taper
phases.goal: Hard-only trap families, final full test, logistics and rest.

weeks.label: Week 1: Baseline and conventions

tasks: Read SAT Essentials — format, timing and scoring (/sat-essentials), 30 min
Read Pacing and Adaptive Modules — how the second module is chosen (/pacing-and-adaptive-modules), 30 min
Read 20 minutes of dense nonfiction (science, history, economics) and summarise each article's claim in one sentence
Clear due Reviews (https://practice.sat.schood.online/reviews), 10 min
Read R&W: Standard English Conventions — boundaries (/reading-writing-conventions), 20 min
SAT Practice Bank: 20 easy and medium questions in Standard English Conventions → Boundaries (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Log misses and guesses in the Notebook with a cause code and a rule sentence (https://practice.sat.schood.online/notebook)
Read Math: Algebra — linear equations in one and two variables (/math-algebra), 20 min
SAT Practice Bank: 20 easy and medium questions in Algebra → Linear equations (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Log misses and guesses in the Notebook with a cause code and a rule sentence (https://practice.sat.schood.online/notebook)
Read 20 minutes of dense nonfiction (science, history, economics) and summarise each article's claim in one sentence
Clear due Reviews (https://practice.sat.schood.online/reviews), 10 min
Full timed mock in the SAT simulator (https://sat.schood.online) at your real test time; one sitting with a 10-minute break
Rest day: no SAT work. Optional 20 minutes of reading nonfiction you enjoy

weeks.checkpoint: Pass: baseline mock taken and two cycle-1 targets chosen (start with conventions and linear algebra unless the mock clearly says otherwise).

Compute (misses × weight) per domain; confirm the cycle-1 targets

SAT Practice Bank: 20 medium questions in Algebra → Systems of linear equations and Linear inequalities (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Read Desmos and Calculator Strategy — graphing, intersections and vertices (/desmos-and-calculator-strategy), 30 min
SAT Practice Bank: 10 medium questions in Algebra, solved twice: algebra and Desmos (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Re-solve Notebook entries from the last 2–3 days without notes; close only correct re-solves
Read 20 minutes of dense nonfiction (science, history, economics) and summarise each article's claim in one sentence
Clear due Reviews (https://practice.sat.schood.online/reviews), 10 min
Timed R&W module set: 27 mixed R&W questions in 32 minutes from the SAT Practice Bank, timer on

weeks.label: Week 7: Hard modules

tasks: Read R&W Hard-Module Traps (premium) — your repeated trap families (/guide-rw-hard-module-traps), 25 min

weeks.checkpoint: Pass: four mocks reviewed; rule sheet drafted; logistics checked.

weeks.label: Week 8: Taper and test

tasks: Timed R&W module set: 27 mixed R&W questions in 32 minutes from the SAT Practice Bank, timer on
Read your rule sheet
Timed Math module set: 22 mixed Math questions in 35 minutes from the SAT Practice Bank, timer on, Desmos allowed
Read your rule sheet
Exam setup in Bluebook and admission ticket (available 5 days before the test): complete setup, print the ticket
Re-solve Notebook entries from the last 10 days without notes; close only correct re-solves
Rules and Desmos refresh: 15 conventions questions; rehearse your five most-used Desmos moves
Confirm route and arrival time
Warm-up only: 6 easy R&W and 6 easy Math questions
Pack your bag; charge the device
Test eve: follow the routine in The Final 14 Days (/guide-final-14-days); no new material
Test day, or shift the week so the test falls after the eve. After the test, rest; plan next steps only when scores arrive

weeks.checkpoint: Pass: exam setup done, ticket printed, bag packed, rest routine followed.

checkpoints.title: Cycle 1 result
checkpoints.pass_rule: Conventions and linear-algebra misses fall from the baseline.
checkpoints.if_not: Carry them into cycle 2 as a third target.

checkpoints.title: Cycle 2 result
checkpoints.pass_rule: Evidence and Advanced Math target misses fall; P/X codes falling.
checkpoints.if_not: Add an extra timed module per section in week 5.

checkpoints.title: Coverage complete
checkpoints.pass_rule: All eight domains drilled; repeated trap families listed.
checkpoints.if_not: Use week 7 day 3 to drill the untouched domain.

checkpoints.title: Ready to test
checkpoints.pass_rule: Logistics complete and rule sheet written.
checkpoints.if_not: Finish exam setup and ticket before any practice.
